verses.text: 15. The same abba said, ‘God remits the debts of sinners who are penitent, for example, the sinful woman and the publican, but of the righteous man he even asks interest. This is what he says to his apostles, “Except your righteousness exceed that of the scribes and pharisees, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.” ’ (Matt. 5.20)
